title: BEND: Spectral Bregman Losses for Multi-Image Unlearning in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models memorize training images and reproduce them almost verbatim when prompted, creating copyright and privacy liabilities. Data unlearning erases the influence of specific training samples from a trained model without retraining, and is two-sided: it must forget the targets while preserving generation quality on everything else. Prior methods use the squared-L2 diffusion loss, at most with a hand-set frequency mask; however, it is known that every Bregman divergence is a mathematically valid choice and the squared-L2 is only the simplest example. BEND is the first to search this family: it fits a spectral Bregman divergence to the unlearning task through a bilevel loop, so the loss itself is shaped to forget thoroughly while protecting quality. It also redirects a memorized image to the mean of its retain images, where ReTrack, the state of the art, redirects it to a single near-copy. On Stable Diffusion, a single BEND mod

translated_title: BEND：用于扩散模型多图像遗忘的频谱 Bregman 损失
translated_abstract: 扩散模型会记住训练图像，并在被提示时近乎原样地复现它们，从而带来版权与隐私方面的责任。数据遗忘旨在无需重新训练的情况下，从已训练的模型中消除特定训练样本的影响，这是一项具有两面性的任务：既要彻底遗忘目标样本，又要保持模型对其他所有内容的生成质量。先前的方法使用平方 L2 扩散损失，至多再配合一个手动设置的频率掩码；然而众所周知，任何 Bregman 散度在数学上都是有效的损失选择，平方 L2 只是其中最简单的例子。BEND 首次对这一散度族进行搜索：它通过双层优化循环为遗忘任务拟合频谱 Bregman 散度，使损失函数本身被塑造成能够在彻底遗忘的同时保护生成质量。此外，BEND 将被记住的图像重定向到其保留图像集合的均值，而现有最先进方法 ReTrack 只是将其重定向到单个近似副本。在 Stable Diffusion 上，单个 BEND 模块……
tldr: BEND 首次通过双层优化在 Bregman 散度族中搜索并拟合频谱遗忘损失，同时将被记住的图像重定向到保留图像的均值，从而在扩散模型中彻底遗忘多张目标图像的同时保持生成质量。
en_tdlr: BEND is the first method to search the Bregman divergence family via a bilevel loop, fitting spectral unlearning losses and redirecting memorized images to the mean of their retain images, thereby thoroughly forgetting multiple target images in diffusion models while preserving generation quality.
